# Buildwise Studios — Executive Search Agent Staffing

> We staff AI agents into headhunting firms — narrow roles, monthly retainer, measured KPIs. Each agent is a hire, not a project.

Buildwise Studios places purpose-built AI agents inside executive search firms — trained on headhunting workflows, not generic inbox tasks. Partners typically reclaim 20+ hours per month per person on work that does not close deals. We audit first, place one agent on a 30-day pilot with measured baselines, then convert to monthly retainer if KPIs hit.
